subject: STAT101
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 high-quality videos, one for each of the 5 topics in both English and Arabic. Selections prioritize conceptual clarity and high viewership to address common student difficulties, such as using Venn diagrams for the addition rule and Bayes' theorem for confusion of the inverse.

coverage.note: The two most relevant candidates failed the view count gate; selected the best video on the underlying concept (Bayes' Theorem).
No videos directly on the fallacy were found; selected the best video on the underlying concept (Bayes' Theorem).
